title: Semester Survival: A University Life Adventure
description: Explore a connected student neighbourhood across eight semesters. Build friendships, attend classes, manage money and shape your future.

maker.name: Joseph Ombati & Antigravity
maker.bio: A collaboration between concept designer Joseph Ombati and Antigravity to create the ultimate premium university simulation running game.

keyboard.A / D or Arrow Left / Right: Walk and move through the neighbourhood
keyboard.E / Enter: Interact with nearby people and objects

touch.swipe: Swipe horizontally to move; swipe up to jump and down to slide; tap nearby people or objects to interact

mouse.description: Select phone tabs, dialogue choices and interface controls

instructions: Begin at student residence, walk through the township to the university, interact with the people you meet and attend orientation. Use the student phone to check your timetable, tasks, map and academic record. This is an early playable vertical slice; the full eight-semester campaign is in production.
